prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 地铁各线路首末班车时刻表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 9 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "线路" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 54px
  col 2: header "工作日首班" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 87px
  col 3: header "工作日末班" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 87px
  col 4: header "周末首班" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 70px
  col 5: header "周末末班" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 70px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 432px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 431px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助乘客按地铁线路查找工作日和周末的首末班车时间。","reading":"先定位线路，再横向读取对应时间；也可纵向比较不同线路，或比较同一线路在工作日与周末的时间。","groups":["工作日首班与工作日末班是一组，周末首班与周末末班是一组，分别表示不同日期类型的运营时段。","两个首班列和两个末班列承担相同角色，便于跨日期类型比较。"],"keep_intact":["线路名称，包括10号线、13号线和机场线","HH:MM格式的时间"],"may_wrap":["列标题可在汉字之间换行；标题行增高后，相邻标题可共用这一行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [75, 109, 109, 69, 69] · table 432×381px · row heights [66, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [75, 86, 86, 92, 92] · table 432×381px · row heights [66, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [75, 88, 88, 71, 71] · table 394×381px · row heights [66, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39, 39] · column headers wrapped 4/5 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"工作日两列宽到 109px，标题一次读完，时间数值左右留白舒服，数据格全部单行，线路列 75px 刚好容下 10号线/13号线/机场线，无断词。","problems":"两对同角色的列宽差得太多（109 对 69），周末两列看起来被挤扁；标题行一半是单行、一半是双行，工作日标题占第一行后下面空一行，周末标题占满两行，标题区显得参差；工作日与周末的对照关系被宽度打断，横向比较变弱。","cause":"把 109 分给第 2、3 列后，第 4、5 列只剩 69px，减去 21px 内边距只有 48px，小于「周末首班」一行所需的 70px，于是只有周末列被迫换行。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"四列时间宽度接近（86/92），整体占满 431px 视口，时间居中留白均匀，表格看起来稳。","problems":"问题和 r1A 正好相反且更别扭：内容更长的「工作日首班」被折成两行，反而较短的「周末首班」一行读完，标题行节奏不一致，工作日两列显局促；同时周末两列 92px 还多出余量，宽度分配与文字长度互相矛盾，成对列的等重感也消失了。","cause":"86−21=65px，小于工作日标题一行所需的 87px 而换行；92−21=71px，刚够 70px 的周末标题一行，于是宽的一对反而是字少的一对。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"三者中最整齐：两对列内部完全等宽（88/88 与 71/71），四个标题都以同样方式折成两行，标题行读成一个整体块，基线统一；无任何断词，时间完整。","problems":"表格只有 394px，右侧留下一条约 37px 的空白带（虚线视口边缘露白），版面像没排满、整体偏左；而且各列都贴着最小值，标题折行是被逼出来的，没有用它换到一点舒展。","cause":"宽度合计 393px（加边框 394），比可用的 431px 少 37px，未使用全部视口；同时因为四个标题全一行需要 4×108+75=507px 远超 431px，折行本身无法避免，只应被均匀、有意识地使用。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"r2A-even-time","widths":[78,88,88,88,88],"change":"四个时间列一律 88px，占满 430px；工作日与周末两对完全等重，四个标题都以 2 行折行，标题块齐整无参差；线路列从 75 加到 78，给 10号线/13号线 一点呼吸；牺牲的是工作日标题本可单行的余量，换来整表节奏一致（全单行需 507px，做不到）。"},{"name":"r2B-pair-weighted","widths":[82,92,92,82,82],"change":"保持两对内部等宽，但把宽度按标题长度分给两对：工作日 92（标题折成 工作日/首班），周末 82（折成 周末/首班）。因为两者都是两行，标题行仍齐平，同时削掉 r1A/r1B 里周末列多余的空白，线路列也略放宽到 82。"},{"name":"r2C-wide-label","widths":[87,86,86,86,86],"change":"新思路：把省下的 37px 全部投入行首列，线路列 87px（内容 66px，与时间列拉开距离），行标签明确独立成列、层级更清楚；四个时间列统一 86px，标题全部两行折行，占满 431px，不再有 r1C 的右侧空白带。"}]}
